entities.summary: Arpi, Argyrippa, and Argos Hippium was an ancient city of Apulia, Italy, 16 miles (26 km) west of the sea coast, and 2 miles (3.5 km) north of modern Foggia. The first name was Argos Hippium then Argyrippa and later Arpi.
